_comment: Every Thai string the add-in shows. VBA source must stay ASCII (it is stored in the machine's code page), so scripts/build-excel-addin.py turns this file into src/modCmasText.bas. Edit here, then run: python scripts/build-excel-addin.py text Write messages as a person would say them: plain Thai sentences, no dashes, dots, arrows or ellipses (21 Nov 2026).
